fragileLine.name: Fragile Line
fragileLine.description: Fragile Line: Suffers +2 extra morale loss whenever attacked in melee combat.

shieldBlock.name: Shield Block
shieldBlock.description: Shield Block: Reduces melee damage by 2 for the first attack received in a turn.

volleyFire.name: Volley Fire
volleyFire.description: Volley Fire: Inflicts 125% ranged damage to targets with >75% units, 100% to 50%-75% units, and 75% to <50% units.

spearWall.name: Spear Wall
spearWall.description: Spear Wall: Reduces incoming melee damage by 2 when attacked from the direction the unit is facing.

impreciseVolley.name: Imprecise Volley
impreciseVolley.description: Imprecise Volley: Inflicts 150% ranged damage to targets with >75% units, 100% to 50%-75% units, and 50% to <50% units.
